name: PT Era Media Sejahtera Tbk
summary: PT Era Media Sejahtera Tbk is an Indonesian firm engaged in the advertising media industry. The company delivers a broad spectrum of advertising services, encompassing transit media (on buses, trains, taxis, and at airports), outdoor solutions like billboards and LED screens, retail and in-shop promotions, as well as modern digital and metaverse advertising. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia, it operates as a subsidiary of Pt Prambanan Investasi Sukses.
